svg.title: Diagram 7. MOG state machine: 7 Rive moods driven by MoodMapper, with lifecycle region A, capture region B and request region C, plus orthogonal overlays and badges
svg.desc: Top: the mood layer of the Rive scene (enum idle, listening, processing, answering, success, error, sleeping). T11 MoodMapper computes the mood as a pure function with the priority paused, capture, error 3 s, success 2.5 s, answering, processing, dozing, idle. At load Bottle sets demo=false and level=0. Overlays attention (M) and recording (S) and badges offline, hop target, sync paused (v1) and STT are orthogonal and never change the mood. Below: three compact swimlanes from the ux-mascot specification. Region A lifecycle nodes A0 to A7 with edges e1 to e11. Region B capture nodes B0 to B8 with edges e1 to e15 (only one MOG owns the mic). Region C request nodes C0 to C20 with edges e1 to e23 (max 2 in flight per MOG). C19 AskUncertain maps to idle with the attention overlay (UX-40). Each lane has an edge table with the triggers.
svg.text: Diagram 7. MOG state machine and Rive mood mapping
V2 MOG view: Rive mood enum (computed by T11 MoodMapper in the brain)
Region to mood: B1-B3 listening; B5 idle + recording; C1-C10, C18 processing;
C11 and reveal answering; C13, C6 success; C14, A5 error; A4, A3 sleeping;
C5, C12, C19 idle + attention. Mood holds >= 400 ms; listening shows in < 100 ms.
e1 A0 -> A1: user Start, or app start with autoStart (refused at running cap)
e2 A1 -> A2: window up, Rive (or PNG fallback) loaded, token OK
e3 A1 or A2 -> A5: databricks auth token fails, or 401 after refresh
e4 A5 -> A2: login done (chip "Sign in")
e5 A2 -> A3: no activity for dozeAfterMin, no session, no request
e6 A3 -> A2: hover, click, hotkey or request event
e7 A2 or A3 -> A4: user Pause MOG, or "Pause all" in the tray
e9 A2 -> A6: reachability probe to the profile host fails 2 times
e10 A6 -> A2: probe OK; queued asks flush in order
e11 any -> A7: Stop or quit; in-flight asks abandoned, late re-poll
Region B: capture (B0-B8; one MOG owns the mic, D20)
e1 B0 -> B1: PTT key-down (global key to last-focused MOG)
e2 B1 -> B2: first audio frame
e3 B1 -> B0: hold < 250 ms (tap), other key in first 1 s, Esc
e4 B2 -> B0 + utterance: key-up (120 s hold safety stop)
e5 B0 -> B3: double-tap PTT, mascot click, "Talk" button
e6 B3 -> B0 + utterance: tap, Esc or 5 min cap (CAP-14)
e7 B0 -> B4: "Start session" (menu, hotkey, accepted prompt)
e8 B4 -> B5: user picks the attestation + Start
e10 B5 <-> B6: Pause / Resume (pause closes the mic)
e11 B5 -> B7: stop signal (SessionGuard, diagram 8) or panic
e12 B7 -> B0: journal flushed, transcript committed
e13 B5, B6 or B7 -> B8 -> B0: "Stop and delete this session"
e14 any capture -> B0: panic key, MOG paused, app quit
e15 B5 -> B5: PTT span goes to the target MOG; no auto-ask
Region C: request (C0-C20; max 2 in flight per MOG, D31; the main agent drives C3-C17, BC4)
e1 C0 -> C1 -> C2 -> C3: STT done; cleanup done or skipped (< 4 words)
e2 C3 -> C4: question, conf >= 0.7, PTT or hands-free (D30)
e3 C3 -> C5: conf < 0.7 (PTT), or any session question (no auto-ask, BC1)
e4 C3 -> end: context to memory; noise dropped; command + toast
e5 C3 -> C6: memory_question or gated hit (same space, <= 24 h)
e6 C6 -> C7: chip "Ask Genie anyway"
e7 C4 -> C7: 1.5 s elapse or Enter
e8 C4 -> C15: Esc or Cancel ("Edit" returns to C0)
e10 (v1) C3 -> C20: split, <= 3 parts; each part runs C7-C16
e12 C7 -> C8: first progress (or elapsed time if steps are null)
e13 C8 <-> C9: retrying or queued, 429 backoff
e14 C8 -> C10: 4 min since ask
e15 C8 or C10 -> C11: partial
e16 C8 or C11 -> C12 -> C8: needs_input; user answers or picks
e17 C8, C10 or C11 -> C13: completed
e18 any active -> C14: failed(code); POLICY_DENIED retries once first
e19 any active -> C15: Esc on card, genie_cancel_response
e20 C10 -> C16: 10 min since ask
e21 C16 -> C17: late re-poll at +15 or +60 min completes
e22 C7 -> C19: timeout after send; user: Check again / Ask again
e23 C14 -> C7: Retry, or "Resend without context"
Tray menu, Pause all and window positions (MB-04, MOG-15; edge e7 in region A)
"Pause all": every Ready or Dozing MOG → A4
every item works with the keyboard
a paused MOG shows mood sleeping;
its capture goes to B0 (region B, e14)
Resume returns each MOG to A2
R11 saves each MOG position as display UUID
+ normalised position. When a display is removed,
its MOGs move to the primary display, so every
Diagram 7. MOG state machine. Seven Rive moods follow a
priority function of regions A, B and C. Overlays and
badges never change the mood. Edge ids link each arrow to
its trigger table. The split (C20, e10) is v1.
